status: Design fixed before first numerical run; precision refinement added after observing a simulated q near 0.05, without changing cohorts, effects, hypotheses or test family
clinical_population: Existing age>=12 and resolved initial dose population (163 patients); no clinical or molecular source changes

eos.target: Dupilumab week-4 group median for explicitly defined observed endpoint cohorts, not individual clinical predictions or an observed point
eos.primary: Patient-specific log(1+EOS) linear-time interpolation between actual week 0 and week 12, then summarize the resulting group median
eos.intervals: Patient bootstrap percentile interval for the median conditional on endpoint-complete selection and chosen temporal shape; missing-cell/shape uncertainty not identified
eos.backchecks: Mask observed W4 among abrocitinib patients with W0/W4/W12; separately mask W12 among dupi complete W0/W12/W24. Neither validates unobserved dupi W4.
eos.limitation: No dupilumab W4 observation exists. An early transient eosinophil rise cannot be recovered or excluded. Shape sensitivities are illustrative, not exhaustive.

baseline_markers.scale: Actual numeric pg/mL export concentrations, without extra dilution multiplier
baseline_markers.summaries: median, Q1, Q3 with linear interpolation/type7 from participant-level values
baseline_markers.eligibility: W0 clinical eligible subjects; observed finite positive assay concentration only
baseline_markers.censoring: No replacement; all assay-state counts retained per analyte and treatment

fixed_triplets.population: For each marker and initial treatment, identical participants have observed finite positive marker at all W0/W12/W24
fixed_triplets.value: Mean of patient-specific log2 concentration differences vs own W0; W0 is reference zero
fixed_triplets.intervals: Pointwise two-sided 95% Student-t CI for mean change, only n>=5
fixed_triplets.test: Two-sided sign flip test of mean paired log2 change, exact for n<=15 otherwise 49,999 Monte Carlo sign vectors with plus-one correction
fixed_triplets.family: 23 markers x 3 initial treatments x 2 baseline contrasts = 138 planned hypotheses
fixed_triplets.adjustment: One Benjamini-Hochberg family of size 138; non-estimable hypotheses assigned p=1 for family calculation and q left missing in displayed rows
fixed_triplets.stars: q<0.05; no W0 test; not reused from prior variable-pair populations
fixed_triplets.interpretation: Within-group paired changes; stars do not establish between-treatment differences
fixed_triplets.numerical_precision_refinement: After initial BH calculation, refine Monte Carlo tests with provisional q in [0.04,0.06]: exact sign enumeration for n<=24 (using global-sign symmetry), otherwise 1,999,999 draws. Recompute the same BH family. Initial p/q values retained; no selection of an effect or test.

joint_low_activity.status: Post hoc descriptive analysis requested 2026-11-07; thresholds fixed before calculating local counts
joint_low_activity.primary_denominator: Both clinical components actually observed at the same visit; no rounding or imputation
joint_low_activity.full_population: All 163 eligible initial-treatment patients, separately 65/56/42 by initial treatment; missing visits retained
joint_low_activity.three_valued_rule: True only when both observed components pass; false if either observed component fails; otherwise unknown
joint_low_activity.bounds: (known true)/N to (known true+unknown)/N, preserving observed component failures; not CIs
joint_low_activity.scope: Single-visit EASI-and-itch states, not full AHEAD MDA, sustained control, or remission
